name: approval_proposals
description: Yêu cầu CREATE/CHANGE/CANCEL; pending_slot UNIQUE chặn hai đề nghị chờ

columns.name: id
columns.type: CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin

columns.name: schedule_id
columns.type: CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin

columns.name: submitted_by
columns.type: CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin

columns.name: base_revision_id
columns.type: CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin
columns.description: Bản hiệu lực làm gốc, NULL với CREATE

columns.name: candidate_revision_id
columns.type: CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin
columns.description: Phương án mới, NULL với CANCEL

columns.name: expires_at
columns.description: Mốc hết quyền xử lý theo DP-07

columns.name: resolved_by
columns.type: CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin
columns.description: Người xử lý; có thể NULL khi hệ thống hết hiệu lực

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Lý do hủy/từ chối/rút/hết hiệu lực

columns.name: pending_slot
columns.type: CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin
columns.description: Cột sinh: chỉ có schedule_id khi PENDING
columns.extra: GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN schedule_id ELSE NULL END) STORED

checks: (kind='CREATE' AND base_revision_id IS NULL AND candidate_revision_id IS NOT NULL) OR (kind='CHANGE' AND base_revision_id IS NOT NULL AND candidate_revision_id IS NOT NULL AND base_revision_id <> candidate_revision_id) OR (kind='CANCEL' AND base_revision_id IS NOT NULL AND candidate_revision_id IS NULL)

(status='PENDING' AND resolved_by IS NULL AND resolved_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED','WITHDRAWN') AND resolved_by IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status='EXPIRED' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL)
status NOT IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED') OR resolved_by <> submitted_by
(kind <> 'CANCEL' AND status NOT IN ('REJECTED','EXPIRED')) OR (reason IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(reason)) > 0)
